name: hypermove.xyz
description: The HyperMove MCP Gateway v4.0 — one Model Context Protocol endpoint for external-protocol integration: cross-chain web3 data (EVM + Stellar + XRPL + Flare + GOAT), FTSO oracle, builder briefs, XRPL ecosystem tools (yield comparison, toolkit directory, hub trending, FXRP bridge status), daily news + AI insight, agentic tools, and per-query x402/MPP payment settled via n-payment. Agent-skills install & run locally in your workspace (GET /api/skills) — MCP is not required to install or run a skill.

transport.note: Connect with any MCP client. POST/GET /api/mcp with Accept: application/json, text/event-stream.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Ranked hybrid search over the unified cross-chain catalog.

tools.name: data.call
tools.description: Execute live cross-chain reads (EVM + Stellar Horizon/Soroban + XRPL + Flare FTSO + GOAT).

tools.name: codemode.news.insight
tools.description: AI-synthesized project insight from today's news.

tools.name: insight.roadmap
tools.description: Synthesize a product-upgrade roadmap from news + capabilities.

tools.name: skillify
tools.description: Codify a task into a reusable skill spec.

tools.name: flare.builder.brief
tools.description: Flare builder brief: FTSO + FAssets + FDC + FCC capabilities + corpus + news. On by default (opt-out via FEATURE_MCP_BUILDER_BRIEF=false).

tools.name: xrpl.builder.brief
tools.description: XRPL builder brief: MPT + vault + lending + amendments + corpus + news. On by default (opt-out via FEATURE_MCP_XRPL_V3=false).

tools.name: goat.builder.brief
tools.description: GOAT builder brief: BTC-native settlement + lending + MPP + corpus + news. On by default (opt-out via FEATURE_MCP_BUILDER_BRIEF=false).

tools.name: xrpl.vault.info
tools.description: XLS-65 single-asset-vault state. Returns a structured amendment_not_active response until SingleAssetVault activates on mainnet. On by default (opt-out via FEATURE_MCP_XRPL_V3=false).

tools.name: xrpl.lending.status
tools.description: XLS-66 lending-protocol state (LoanBroker/Loan). Returns a structured amendment_not_active response until Lending activates on mainnet. On by default (opt-out via FEATURE_MCP_XRPL_V3=false).

tools.name: xrpl.yield.compare
tools.description: Compare live XRP/RLUSD yield venues (Soil, Flare-Monarq, Doppler) by rate, lock-up, model, bridge requirement. Source-labeled, not investment advice. On by default (opt-out via FEATURE_MCP_XRPL_V3=false).

tools.name: xrpl.toolkit.list
tools.description: Canonical directory of SDKs, CLIs, facilitators, agent skills for XRPL agentic payments (sourced from xrpl-ai.org/resources). Always available.

tools.name: xrpl.hub.trending
tools.description: Live XRPL AI Hub index snapshot (agentic payments, merchants, provider concentration) + current amendment-vote status. On by default (opt-out via FEATURE_MCP_XRPL_V3=false).

tools.name: flare.fassets.bridgeStatus
tools.description: FXRP bridge lifecycle, adoption stats, use cases — the XRP-to-Flare cross-chain path. On by default (opt-out via FEATURE_MCP_FLARE_V1=false).

tools.name: payments.settle
tools.description: Settle a payment via n-payment (x402/MPP) to unlock a paid session. 5 free calls / 24h, then per-call across four rails.

resources.name: FTSO Price Feed
resources.description: Live block-latency price feed from Flare FTSO. On by default (opt-out via FEATURE_MCP_RESOURCES=false).

resources.name: XRPL Amendments
resources.description: Enabled + in-voting amendments. On by default (opt-out via FEATURE_MCP_RESOURCES=false or FEATURE_MCP_XRPL_V3=false).

resources.name: FXRP Bridge Capacity
resources.description: FAssets XRP bridge capacity. On by default (opt-out via FEATURE_MCP_RESOURCES=false or FEATURE_MCP_FLARE_V1=false).

prompts.name: builder.brief
prompts.description: Synthesize a decision-ready builder brief for a chain. On by default (opt-out via FEATURE_MCP_BUILDER_BRIEF=false).

prompts.name: settlement.quote
prompts.description: Compare RLUSD vs XRP settlement cost/finality. On by default (opt-out via FEATURE_MCP_XRPL_V3=false).
